justification: After removing the canibuildit->plotdetect redirect (#591), canibuildit.com.au served the SAME PlotDetect info homepage as plotdetect.com.au. But canibuildit is meant to be the satellite apps site (the /reports section), not a clone of the info homepage. Add a hostname rewrite in middleware mirroring the existing verify.plotdetect.com.au -> /assessment rule: canibuildit.com.au (and www) root rewrites to /reports (the satellite landing). plotdetect.com.au root is untouched and stays the info site.

pre_impl.existing_data: middleware already does hostname routing: isVerifyDomain (verify.plotdetect.com.au) at pathname '/' rewrites to /assessment, reading host from x-forwarded-host first (reliable behind Cloudflare+Vercel). The satellite section app/reports has its own layout and a landing page app/reports/page.tsx titled 'Property Intelligence Reports — NSW'.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: Removing the redirect (#591) was assumed to make canibuildit its own site, but with no host routing it just rendered the shared root (the PlotDetect info homepage). The domain needs to map to the satellite section, not the info root.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: No new mechanism. Adds isCanibuilditDomain (apex + www) and one rewrite to /reports, directly mirroring the existing isVerifyDomain rewrite. plotdetect.com.au and verify.plotdetect.com.au paths are unaffected.

functions.name: middleware
functions.input: the incoming NextRequest, from which host is read via x-forwarded-host then host then nextUrl.hostname
functions.output: for the canibuildit apex/www host at pathname '/', an internal NextResponse.rewrite to /reports; all other hosts and paths fall through unchanged
functions.if_none: host not canibuildit, or path not '/' -> no rewrite; verify and plotdetect behaviour is preserved exactly

values: N/A - no regulatory values; this is host-based request routing only.

break_it.scenario: The /reports landing needs an auth/session the rewrite path does not get, so canibuildit root renders blank or bounces
break_it.what_happens: the satellite home could fail to render for anonymous visitors
break_it.repro: hit canibuildit.com.au/ logged out after deploy
break_it.how: this mirrors the working verify -> /assessment rewrite; it is a rewrite (URL stays /), and /reports is a public marketing landing with its own layout, not a gated route; the session-refresh branch only augments /reports/* tool pages, it does not block the landing

break_it.scenario: www.canibuildit.com.au does not match the apex rule and serves the info homepage
break_it.what_happens: the www host would show the wrong site
break_it.how: isCanibuilditDomain matches BOTH canibuildit.com.au and www.canibuildit.com.au; additionally Vercel 307s www to apex, so the apex rule also covers it

break_it.scenario: host is misread behind Cloudflare so the rule fires on the wrong domain (e.g. plotdetect shows /reports)
break_it.what_happens: the info site could be replaced by the satellite section
break_it.how: host is read via x-forwarded-host first (the same reliable source the existing verify rule uses) and matched by exact string equality against only the two canibuildit hosts, so plotdetect.com.au and verify.plotdetect.com.au never match

post_merge.secrets: None - no secrets or env vars.
post_merge.other_repo: N/A - the Next.js frontend auto-deploys on Vercel from GitHub on merge.
post_merge.manual_verify: After deploy (bust cache with ?cb=N): canibuildit.com.au/ shows the satellite landing 'Property Intelligence Reports'; plotdetect.com.au/ still shows the PlotDetect info homepage; verify.plotdetect.com.au/ still serves /assessment. canibuildit.com.au/reports/solar-yield still works.
